stopPoints.label: 00:22 场景：美丽的雪山和森林
stopPoints.question:
提问（看图猜天气）：'Look at the trees. Is it sunny ☀️ or snowing ❄️?'
引导：'It's snowing! There is white snow on the trees.'

stopPoints.label: 00:31 场景：Poby和Harry在睡觉
stopPoints.question:
提问（Yes/No 问答）：'Are Poby and Harry sleeping?'
选项/引导：'Yes, they are.' 或者 'No, they aren't.' 引导孩子回答：'Yes!'

stopPoints.label: 00:34 场景：Poby打哈欠伸懒腰
stopPoints.question:
互动（肢体模仿 TPR）：老师大声说：'Wake up! Let's stretch like Poby!' 伸大双臂做伸懒腰的动作。
引导：引导孩子跟着老师一起做伸懒腰的动作，说出：'Wake up!'

stopPoints.label: 00:38 场景：小鸟Harry倒立摔倒
stopPoints.question:
提问（动作认知）：'Oh no, look at Harry! Is he standing up or upside down (倒过来)?'
引导：'He is upside down! Silly Harry! Can you shake your head like him?' 引导孩子模仿Harry摇晃身体。

stopPoints.label: 00:47 场景：小鸟停在Poby的头顶上
stopPoints.question:
提问（方位选择问答）：'Where is the little bird? Is it under the head or on the head?'
选项：老师手摸头顶：'A) On the head? B) Under the head?'
引导：引导孩子说出：'On the head!'

stopPoints.label: 01:05 场景：朋友们在雪地上集合
stopPoints.question:
提问（人物数数/认知）：'Wow, so many friends! Let's count, how many friends can you see?'
引导：老师伸出手指带孩子数一数：'One, two, three, four, five! Five friends!'

stopPoints.label: 01:12 场景：Eddy开着他的灰色小飞机
stopPoints.question:
提问（物品与颜色）：'What is Eddy driving? Is it a car 🚗 or a plane ✈️?'
引导：'It's a plane! It has wings!'

stopPoints.label: 01:33 场景：Pororo和Crong准备起飞
stopPoints.question:
提问（Yes/No 问答）：'Are they ready to fly?'
引导：'Yes! Let's say together: Ready, set, go! 🚀'

stopPoints.label: 01:42 场景：飞机在空中不稳要摔下来了
stopPoints.question:
提问（情绪/动作）：'Oh dear! Is the plane flying high or falling down?'
引导：'It's falling down! Oh no!'

stopPoints.label: 01:50 场景：飞机挂在了树枝上
stopPoints.question:
提问（位置认知）：'Where is the plane now? Is it in the water or on the tree 🌲?'
引导：'It's on the tree! It crashed into the tree!'

stopPoints.label: 01:54 场景：Pororo和Crong脸上贴着创可贴
stopPoints.question:
提问（情绪认知）：'Are they happy or sad?'
引导：'They look sad 😢. Their faces are dirty and hurt.'

stopPoints.label: 02:02 场景：Eddy展示了一架更棒的蓝色炫酷飞机
stopPoints.question:
提问（颜色认知）：'Look! What color is this new plane? Is it yellow 💛 or blue 💙?'
引导：'It's blue! A beautiful blue plane!'

stopPoints.label: 02:03 场景：朋友们张大嘴巴非常惊讶
stopPoints.question:
互动（表情模仿 TPR）：'Look at their faces! Wow!'
引导：老师做出双手捧颊、张大嘴巴的惊讶表情：'Can you make a surprised face like them? Say: Wow!'

stopPoints.label: 02:06 场景：Pororo高兴地趴在飞机罩上
stopPoints.question:
提问（Yes/No 问答）：'Do they like the new blue plane?'
引导：'Yes! They like it very much! Look at Pororo, he is so happy!'
